text:
matt-partnerships: FYI TempoCore reports doubled-minute counts for some customers since 06:00 UTC. partner sees duplicate heartbeats from gateways.

anya-engineering: can you paste a raw event they sent?

matt-partnerships: sample from their gateway: ```json
{\"hw_id\":\"tc-77\",\"ts\":\"2026-03-23T06:12:00Z\",\"minutes\":1,\"sig\":\"s1gX\"}
``` they followed up 2s later with same body but a new signature.

li-finance: we surfaced +2.1k minutes in pending ledger for several enterprise accounts. hold billing for impacted customers until we reconcile.

kevin-sre: what's the ingest path? could a retry be replayed across frontends?

anya-engineering: ingest path: api-gw -> verifier -> envelope-store -> event-queue -> hourly-rollup. we validate signatures but don't require an idempotency token, so re-signed retries look valid.

ingest-bot: alert: partner-heartbeat-duplicates detected, partner=tempo-core, sample_count=95

matt-partnerships: tempo says gateway retries on 5xx and they can't ship idempotency headers for ~72h while they patch edge.

anya-engineering: short-term options: (A) reject replays at api-gw using an HMAC-of-body cache (30s window) stored in Redis; (B) dedupe at hourly-rollup by collapsing identical (hw_id, ts) pairs and marking duplicates; (C) mark suspected duplicates for manual review. A prevents downstream churn, B is lower risk.

kevin-sre: (A) requires state at the edge and sizing for Redis keys/eviction; (B) safe and quick. which do we want now?

li-finance: priority is to avoid incorrect invoices. if (B) prevents double-counts before invoices are generated that's fine. we will not auto-issue refunds until reconciliation confirms customer impact.

anya-engineering: plan: implement (B) immediately: rollup dedupe by (hw_id, ts) within a 60s window, add tag "tempo_dedupe_v1" on collapsed rows. keep (A) as a fallback if duplicates continue after partner patch.

matt-partnerships: tempo agreed to provide an audit CSV with their internal request ids and gateway logs. they will also add an optional request_uuid in their next SDK push.

kevin-sre: I'll add metric partner_duplicate_events.count and a dashboard widget. alert threshold >50/min.

ingest-bot: runbook: https://go/redwood/partner-ingest/tempo-dedupe-runbook

anya-engineering: owners and targets: rollup dedupe (anya) target 2h; api-gw short-window cache (kevin) target 6h if needed; reconciliation job (matt) target EOD once partner CSV arrives; finance hold (li) until reconciliation completes.

matt-partnerships: i'll draft a short customer-facing blurb and coordinate with the partner PM. also adding mandatory request_uuid to webhook contract and a 7-day SLA for gateway rollout in onboarding docs.

li-finance: confirmed: billing hold applied to impacted accounts and flags in the billing dashboard.

anya-engineering: rolled out the rollup change. dedupe collapsed 102 duplicate events across three accounts. PR: https://git.redwood/ingest/rollups/pull/721

kevin-sre: dashboard live, alerting set. no noticeable CPU or latency regression on rollup workers.

matt-partnerships: tempo delivered CSV. reconciliation matched our collapsed set and showed 8 extra late duplicates. we'll run a targeted cleanup and flag ledger entries for manual adjustment.

li-finance: we'll schedule a single billing adjustment run tomorrow to apply corrections.

anya-engineering: cleanup job marked 8 rows as "partner_confirmed_duplicate" and emitted a backfill tag.

matt-partnerships: partner and customer notes sent. closing thread unless anyone has follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
